method: Actual decoded frozen production GLB vertices, normals, materials and absolute production rig transforms. Native EGL/Mesa offline rasterization; production light values and ACES, approximate standard-material GGX/area reflections. Every production mesh retained with original materials. No browser, PMREM, shadow map, fog, dynamics or manufacturing validation. No masks, retouching or replacement geometry. Camera views do not claim exact screenshot camera registration. Images do not prove clearance; independent geometric validation owns collision conclusions.
